independence.options_provenance: Authored independently from general knowledge after resolving the current requester meaning and reading the bound creative controls.

ordered_choices.title: Last folio at the station canopy
ordered_choices.purpose: A bookbinder must move an open repaired folio into shelter before a gust bends its loose page.
ordered_choices.difficulty: Wind enters under the station canopy while a damp bench makes setting the folio down unsafe.
ordered_choices.current_action: She draws the folio toward her chest while her free palm catches the lifting page.
ordered_choices.visible_result: One curled page settles under her palm while the folio edge and her coat hem still lift toward the wind.

ordered_choices.title: Seeds rescued at a harbor loading shed
ordered_choices.purpose: A seed keeper is packing labelled paper seed packets into a wooden case before a departing ferry is loaded.
ordered_choices.difficulty: A gust through the loading shed lifts the lightweight packets.
ordered_choices.current_action: She presses a folded packet into a case with her right hand while her left palm holds two remaining packets on a crate.
ordered_choices.visible_result: The case contains neat rows of packets while one unheld corner still flutters above the crate.

ordered_choices.title: Drying prints beside an orchard wall
ordered_choices.purpose: A printmaker is hanging a fresh botanical print to dry during a brief clear interval.
ordered_choices.difficulty: A breeze curls the still-damp bottom edge toward the wet stone wall.
ordered_choices.current_action: She clips the top edge to a low drying line while her free hand guides its curled bottom away from the wall.
ordered_choices.visible_result: The already-clipped corner hangs straight while the opposite lower corner remains curled in her hand.

ordered_choices.title: A clock repairer closing a market stall
ordered_choices.purpose: A clock repairer must protect a repaired wall clock before carrying it across an autumn market square.
ordered_choices.difficulty: A brief shower has left the open shipping case rim wet.
ordered_choices.current_action: She slides a folded cloth over the case rim and lowers the clock into a padded recess.
ordered_choices.visible_result: The lower clock edge rests in its dry fitted recess while a droplet beads on the covered outer rim.

ordered_choices.title: A torn kite at the hilltop shelter
ordered_choices.purpose: A kite mender is returning a patched kite to flying shape before the wind subsides.
ordered_choices.difficulty: Wind pulls the slack bridle against an unfinished cloth patch.
ordered_choices.current_action: She braces the kite against a shelter rail and presses a sewn patch flat with one hand while holding the bridle clear with the other.
ordered_choices.visible_result: The patch lies flat and the bridle remains separated from it while the outer kite fabric bows in the breeze.

ordered_choices.title: The last daylight chart at the observatory
ordered_choices.purpose: An observatory assistant carries a paper sky chart from an outdoor table into the instrument room.
ordered_choices.difficulty: A gust pushes the chart toward a recently wet stone ledge.
ordered_choices.current_action: She gathers the chart into a rigid folder while keeping its curled corner elevated with her free hand.
ordered_choices.visible_result: Most of the chart is protected inside the folder while one curled corner remains raised beside her wrist.

reference.scope: Visible face and hair guide a newly invented adult person. Wardrobe, body staging, setting and crop are open creative choices.
observed_cues: short black bob curving inward around the jaw

controls.authoring_application: Subtle human attraction is expressed through attentive presence, relaxed lips and softly revealed facial planes within a practical, inhabited autumn-fashion scene. Complex causality is requested; restrained creativity develops it without impossible effects or ornamental plot additions.

primary_authorial_direction_before_catal.whole_image: A poised yet interrupted autumn-fashion photograph: a fictional observatory assistant keeps a loose sky chart dry as she turns from a damp terrace toward a warmly lit instrument-room doorway. Her immediate attention and the visible curl of paper connect clothing, body and weather in one purposeful moment.
primary_authorial_direction_before_catal.viewer_experience: Interest in whether the delicate paper clears the wet ledge, together with quiet attraction to the subject and tactile contrast between wool, cable knit, corduroy and leather.

alternatives_compared.direction: A still portrait with the closed chart portfolio already protected
alternatives_compared.assessment: Clear clothing silhouette and quiet presence, but the difficulty and visible rescue result would be mostly absent.

alternatives_compared.direction: A gust interrupts the carry; the chart is partly inside the portfolio and the free corner is visibly held above the wet ledge
alternatives_compared.assessment: One small action explains the circumstances, preserves a readable front of the outfit and supplies a visible partial result without extra actors or plot props.

open_scene_choices: cool daylight and warm doorway light
feature_targets_authored_before_catalog: Double-breasted peacoat construction: broad notched lapels, two button rows, short separate open fronts.
Wool surface shows a soft brushed nap rather than knit loops or corduroy wales.
Cream cable-knit sweater is visibly inside the coat, with raised cable columns at the exposed front and cuffs extending beyond coat sleeves.
Russet corduroy skirt exposes distinct narrow vertical pile wales below the hip-length coat.
Chestnut leather ankle boots show tied laces and ankle flex creases at the hem gap.
primary_authorial_direction_before_catal.causal_sequence: The chart is being carried indoors; the gust curls its exposed corner toward a wet ledge; one hand lifts the corner while the other arm steadies the portfolio; the lower chart is already sheltered inside while the raised corner remains dry.

precore_scene_review.keywords_hidden_assessment: Even without the synopsis, a paper corner held above beaded stone, its protected lower section and a lit doorway explain a small interrupted carry. Clothes retain an independent silhouette and tactile contrasts; attention is directed to the fragile corner rather than a generic emotional adjective. The actual urgency and fictional job remain interpretive, while the protection action is visible.
precore_scene_review.embodiment_status: agent-supported prose realization; no rendered pixels yet
precore_scene_review.ownership: Only the autumn-fashion topic and supplied visible face/hair reference meaning are bound. Particular garments, role, chart incident, pose and camera remain authorial choices on open dimensions.

pixel_test_goals_authored_from_baseline.expectation: Navy hip-length open peacoat with broad notched lapels and two button rows is recognizable.
A soft brushed wool surface is distinguishable from the raised knit loops and corduroy ribs.
Cream cable-knit sits inside the open coat, with the exposed front and cuffs visibly layered under the navy sleeves.
Russet midi-skirt has narrow vertical pile ribs below the short coat.
Chestnut tied-lace ankle boots show leather and ankle creases; both boots are within the frame.
The pinch lifts a curled paper corner above wet ledge while the other arm supports a portfolio sheltering the lower sheet.
The fictional adult portrayal preserves the directly observed face cues, short black bob and wispy bangs.
